content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HLL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by HLL Lifecare (HLL) for filling various pharmacist positions on a contract basis across designated healthcare facilities.

faq.question: Q2. What posts are available under HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Assistant Pharmacist and Pharmacist Grades IV, III, II, and I under the healthcare field division of HLL Lifecare.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for HLL jobs?
faq.answer: The application mode for these positions is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to directly attend the walk-in selection process at the designated venue on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 02-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they report to the venue within the designated time frame.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Assistant Pharmacist?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Assistant Pharmacist position must possess a D.Pharm or B.Pharm degree, and freshers are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q6. Is experience required for Pharmacist Grade I posts?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants for Pharmacist Grade I require a minimum of 8 years of post-qualification experience in a retail pharmacy setting alongside D.Pharm or B.Pharm qualifications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts under this HLL recruitment notification is 37 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will take place at AMRIT Pharmacy, Near OPD Premises, NIMHANS Hospital, Bengaluru – 560029, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original certificates along with self-attested copies of age proof, educational qualifications, mark sheets, experience certificates, latest salary break-up, Aadhaar, PAN, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for HLL Pharmacist recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the candidates attending the walk-in interview comprises a Written Test followed by a personal Interview.
